messages:
maya: Quick Q — where are our canonical log searches for model errors (by org/model/route/region/status)? Need to debug a spike for acme corp.
dan: We keep most in Datadog saved views + a Kibana fallback. Which view do you need?
maya: Prefer Datadog. I need to check 5xx rate for rpt-2 on /v1/generate in us-west.
dan: Try this saved view: "SRE — model 5xx by org/model" (team folder). Query you can paste in Datadog explorer:
```
service:redwood-inference AND org_id:acme AND model:rpt-2 AND route:"/v1/generate" AND region:us-west AND status:[500 TO 599]
```
Also a quick aggregation suggestion:
```
count() by {model, org_id, route, region, status}
```
sasha: FYI we also have prebuilt dashboards: 
- Model errors dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.team/d/mdl_errors
- Live logs shortcut: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Aredwood-inference%20AND%20model%3Arpt-2
maya: Any saved search name I can add to my Datadog heirarchy?
dan: Saved names we use: 
- SRE:model-5xx-by-org-model (Datadog saved view)
- Ops:model-failure-trace (Kibana saved search)
- prod:route-error-high (Datadog monitor)
sasha: If you want, I can add a focused saved view like "acme-rpt2-usw-5xx" to the team folder. @maya want that?
maya: yes pls. Also add a short granular filter for status codes and latency > 500ms.
dan: Datadog snippet for combined status+latency (paste into Explorer and save):
```
service:redwood-inference AND org_id:acme AND model:rpt-2 AND route:"/v1/generate" AND region:us-west AND status:[500 TO 599] AND latency_ms:>500
```
alertbot: Incident bot: New alert created — monitor: prod:route-error-high — triggered 3 times in 5m.
maya: ok thanks. can one of you paste the Kibana saved-search query so I can run historical 7-day?
sasha: Kibana (Discover) query to paste in the search bar:
```
(org: "acme" AND model.keyword: "rpt-2" AND route.keyword: "/v1/generate" AND region: "us-west" AND response.status:[500 TO 599]) OR latency:>500
```
dan: I'll create the Datadog saved view and share the link here when done.
maya: perfect. Can you also add the saved query to the shared SRE folder? Link to add: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs/explorer/saved_views
dan: done — new saved view: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?saved_view=9876-acme-rpt2-usw-5xx
maya: verified, thanks :thumbsup:
sasha: Note: when you run that query, toggle "group by" to route then model — helps find noisy endpoints quickly.
maya: got it. closing this thread once we have the dashboard pinned.
